reviews.review_title: One of my new favourite games but
reviews.review_description:
I love it its one of my new favourite games but sometimes whenever i try to grab something it grabs the hammer instead.

But that aside its really good and i hope it gets more updates

For the people who done one star review, there’s something wrong with you this game has great features great building and unlimited create creativity the only thing I want them to add is multiplayer ￼￼￼
Just wish they could find a way to make axe/saw progress appear anywhere instead of designated height but that's whatever this games still absolutely incredible.
The tools are amazing and the power tools like the chainsaw or the jackhammer the building is so good. Everyone should play this game
The game is amazing, but they should add multiplayer I really wanna play with my friends. Please answer Dev's owner, please. We need multiplayer!!!
You do not have the ability to save your game. This game would be pretty good, but should be taken out of the meta store because it is a waist of money if you can't save your progress.

developer_response.body: To save your progress in the game, you need to grab the tablet behind your back with your right hand. It contains the game settings and saves. All of this is shown in the tutorial mode when you start the game. We would appreciate it if you could update your review so it doesn't confuse other players
